description:
Look up the current status of a USPS package by its tracking number.

    Returns the status, USPS's one-line summary, the expected delivery date and the latest scan
    (what happened, when, and the city and state). The same information usps.com shows anyone who
    has the number. USPS packages only: a UPS number gets an error pointing to ups.com.
name: track_package
title: Track a Package
